# Context and objectives

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 1 · Context and objectives

Parent page: [Cognitive Workspace](../0-home/home.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:bbac7b2a9707f154 -->
enable-spa is a single-page application on Firebase (Hosting, Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Functions v2 in europe-west1) serving three audiences: citizens who request a device through a public form, volunteers who build and ship devices, and administrators who coordinate everything. The discovery context records the shared constraints that shape every domain: personal data of requesters is always kept separate from the main request document, every callable logs to the security log, emails are queued through the Trigger Email extension rather than sent directly, and access is governed by a two-role RBAC model with a separate super-admin flag for platform operations.

The glossary page, computed from the workspace, collects the terms used across domains. This section deliberately does not restate the project scope beyond this: the perimeter of each domain is described in its own chapter in section 3. The workspace does not document business goals, success metrics or non-functional targets; this gap is reported in section 8.
